feud.name: Locker room feud
feud.definition: A public dispute between two teammates, reported by the press.
feud.inclusion_criteria: At least one national outlet reports the dispute and names both players.
feud.exclusion_criteria: An argument during a game, which conflict between players covers.
feud.dating_rule: The day of the first report by a national outlet.
feud.generic_example: Player A and player B of team X argue after practice, and a national outlet reports it.
possible_overlaps: Conflict between players covers an argument during a game.

standoff.name: Contract standoff
standoff.definition: The player refuses in public to report to his team over his contract.
standoff.inclusion_criteria: The player or his agent states the refusal in public.
standoff.exclusion_criteria: A negotiation that nobody makes public.
standoff.dating_rule: The day the refusal is first reported.
standoff.generic_example: Player A skips the first practice of team X, and a national outlet reports why.

benching.name: Public benching
benching.definition: The coach removes the player from the starting five and says why in public.
